richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bidar

c: Bidar stands on a laterite plateau in the north-east corner of Karnataka, close to Telangana and Maharashtra, and is known for its fort and its Bidriware metalwork. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bidar to schools, colleges, government and defence campuses, municipal parks and residential layouts. We build the Fun Fitness range at our Vasai factory, about 510 km away, and deliver by road.

The red laterite ground of the plateau is hard and stony in places, which affects how machines are fixed. Where the surface is firm and level, some machines can stand on their own base. Where it is broken or sloping, we grout each post into concrete. The climate is a little milder than the plains below, with hot summers and a moderate monsoon. Strong sun still fades cheap plastic, so our seats and handles are roto-moulded for outdoor use.
Before we send a quote, we ask for photos of the ground at each spot where a machine will stand. That tells us whether to grout or use a self-standing base. Popular choices for a Bidar campus are the
for the back and arms, and the
for stiff shoulders. Level the area first and fill the low spots with murram so rainwater does not collect under the seats.

items.q: Can you install outdoor gym equipment on rocky ground in Bidar?
items.a: Yes. On hard or broken laterite we grout each post into a concrete footing. On a firm, level surface some machines can be self-standing. We decide after seeing photos of the site.

items.q: Do you supply campuses in north Karnataka?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install with our own team or a dealer covering south India. Send us the site details and we will prepare a layout.

items.q: How often should the machines be checked?
items.a: A quick look every week for loose bolts or damage, and a proper check of moving parts every few months. Our after-sales team can help with spares.
